title: [EPILEPSY WARNING] How fast should an unoptimized terminal run?
summary: Casey Muratori shows how fast a terminal renderer can run, building a simple reference renderer that handles Unicode and colored text far quicker than Windows Terminal. He argues that common excuses for slow terminals do not hold up.
why: It is the canonical reference for the claim that modern software wastes hardware, and the proof-of-concept behind the Windows Terminal performance debate.

quote.text: Casey spent <1 week making RefTerm, a skeleton proto-terminal with the same constraints Microsoft people had
